name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
description: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (now marketed by Salesforce as Agentforce Commerce) is a unified enterprise commerce platform connecting ecommerce, order management, and point of sale, with AI agents built into merchandising and shopping.
best_for: Large enterprise and multi-brand retailers that need a unified platform spanning online storefronts, in-store point of sale, and cross-channel order management.
features: AI-native search that interprets shopper intent
Agentforce Merchant, Buyer, and Personal Shopper agents for merchandising and guided shopping
Cross-channel order management on a single codebase
Data 360 zero-copy access unifying storefront, marketing, and service data into real-time customer profiles
B2B Commerce tools for custom catalogs, pricing, and purchasing workflows

alternatives.name: Adobe Commerce
alternatives.description: Adobe's enterprise ecommerce platform for B2B and B2C businesses with deep customization and multi-site management.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises needing highly customized catalog, pricing, and storefront logic.

alternatives.name: BigCommerce
alternatives.description: A SaaS ecommerce platform for building and scaling online stores with built-in enterprise features.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-market and enterprise retailers wanting built-in features without heavy customization overhead.

alternatives.name: Shopify
alternatives.description: A hosted commerce platform for building and managing online stores across web, mobile, and in-person sales.
alternatives.best_for: Brands wanting a fully managed platform with rapid time-to-launch.
